title: The Twelve Sealed Tombs
tagline: An explorer, an engineer and one very small desert cat. Twelve sealed tombs. One family secret.

lead.name: Shen Lia
lead.look: early thirties, short black bob, dust-grey field jacket, brass surveying compass on a cord, notebook full of sketches
lead.method: reads a place before she enters it: wind, water, slope and the way the builders thought

partner.name: Arlo Kwan
partner.look: tall, rolled sleeves, leather tool roll, round spectacles pushed up on his head
partner.skill: locks, counterweights, water clocks; never forces a door he can open

pet.name: Pebble
pet.look: tufted ears, ringed tail, one white paw
pet.skill: finds draughts and hollow stones; comic relief; never in danger

bible.tone: adventurous and atmospheric, eerie but never horror: no gore, no undead, no curses that hurt anyone; every 'ghost' sign has a real cause or stays a legend; the team protects sites and never loots
recurring: each volume ends with Lia taking a rubbing of the tomb's seal on rice paper
a rival collector, the Lacquer Hand, arrives one step late in every volume
rules: inspired only by public-domain sources: ancient Chinese texts and legends, historical records and early explorers' reports; names, plots, mechanisms and puzzles are new
no element from any modern tomb-raiding novel or series (no borrowed sects, titles, rituals, characters or artefacts)
puzzle answers are built by code and verified by an independent solver; AI never decides an answer
each volume has a new site, a new kind of mechanism and a new way of combining clues

series_arc.model: Each volume is one sealed tomb solved end to end. Under it runs one long secret about Lia's own family; every volume hands the reader one seal and one letter.
series_arc.secret: Lia's grandmother left her an ink stone carved with a seal that matches the first tomb exactly.
series_arc.question: Who sealed the twelve tombs, and why does every seal carry the Shen family mark?
series_arc.collectible: twelve seal rubbings, one per tomb, each with one letter and one direction
series_arc.mechanic: The last page of every volume is the Rubbing Page: the reader keeps the letter and the direction. Volume 12's final puzzle needs all twelve.
rules: the arc piece is won by solving the volume's own final puzzle
an arc piece never spoils that volume's solution
each volume's last line points at the next tomb
volume 12 answers the question fully and fairly

volumes.title: The Mercury River Gate
volumes.setting: a sealed hill tomb on the yellow loess plain, early spring

inspired_by.work: Records of the Grand Historian: the First Emperor's tomb (rivers of mercury, set crossbows)
inspired_by.author: Sima Qian

volumes.clue_mechanic: trap-and-trigger map (which floor stone fires which mechanism)
volumes.final_form: safe path drawn across the tomb floor

twists.maze: floor stones that may not be stepped twice

volumes.method: the trap that only fires for the impatient

arc_clue.found: the first seal rubbing, stamped with a mark Lia has only seen on her grandmother's ink stone

volumes.title: The Fox Lantern of the Ruined Temple
volumes.setting: a mountain temple ruin where a lantern burns with no one to light it

inspired_by.work: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio (fox-spirit tales)
inspired_by.author: Pu Songling

volumes.clue_mechanic: explain-the-apparition (every 'ghost' sign has a natural cause)
volumes.final_form: table of omens with their real causes
volumes.method: the fake haunting that guards a real secret

arc_clue.found: the lantern's base hides the second seal: the 'fox' was a hermit keeping it safe, and he knows Lia's family name

volumes.title: The Beast of the Western Mountains
volumes.setting: a cliff cave mapped in an ancient bestiary
volumes.clue_mechanic: bestiary cross-reference (match each carved beast to its mountain and direction)
volumes.final_form: compass rose of beasts and directions
volumes.method: the map that only works if read as a bestiary

arc_clue.found: the carved ninth beast holds the third seal in its open mouth

volumes.title: The City Buried by Sand
volumes.setting: a dried lakeshore city of mud-brick towers in the desert

inspired_by.work: Loulan ruins as reported by early explorers
inspired_by.author: Sven Hedin (expedition reports)

volumes.clue_mechanic: wind-and-dune timeline (what the sand covered first)
volumes.final_form: layered dig plan in the right order

twists.wordsearch: place names on a wooden tally

volumes.method: the trail covered by the wind, read by what it covered last

arc_clue.found: a wooden tally slip names the keeper of the fourth seal: a Shen

volumes.title: The Monk's Record of the Western Lands
volumes.setting: a cliff of painted caves on the old caravan road

inspired_by.work: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions
inspired_by.author: Xuanzang

volumes.clue_mechanic: travel-log distances (days of walking turned into places on a map)
volumes.final_form: route plotted from a pilgrim's travel log
volumes.method: directions hidden in an old travel diary

arc_clue.found: a painted cave shows the fifth seal hidden in a mural's halo

volumes.title: The Library Behind the Painted Wall
volumes.setting: a walled-up cave library on the edge of an oasis town

inspired_by.work: The sealed library cave of Dunhuang (opened 1900)
inspired_by.author: historical record

volumes.clue_mechanic: manuscript patchwork (torn pages matched by edge, ink and paper)
volumes.final_form: reassembled scroll that reads one sentence
volumes.method: the false wall that hides an older wall

arc_clue.found: the sixth seal is stamped on a scroll that was cut into strips; the scroll is a guardians' oath

volumes.title: The Jade Suit Puzzle
volumes.setting: a prince's tomb with a burial suit of jade tiles

inspired_by.work: Han dynasty jade burial suits (historical record)
inspired_by.author: historical record

volumes.clue_mechanic: tile-and-thread tiling (which tiles fit, sewn in which order)
volumes.final_form: completed tile layout of the suit
volumes.method: the treasure that is a puzzle in itself

arc_clue.found: a jade tile sewn with sea-blue thread is the seventh seal

volumes.title: The Burial Book of Wind and Water
volumes.setting: a valley chosen by an old geomancer, with three false tombs

inspired_by.work: The Book of Burial (feng shui classic)
inspired_by.author: Guo Pu

volumes.clue_mechanic: landform reading (which of three tombs sits where wind and water meet)
volumes.final_form: the one true tomb chosen on a landform map
volumes.method: three decoy tombs and one true one

arc_clue.found: the true tomb's threshold stone is carved with the eighth seal

volumes.title: The Thousand-Character Lock
volumes.setting: a scholar's tomb guarded by a lock of written characters
volumes.clue_mechanic: character-order lock (each line of the old primer sets one wheel)
volumes.final_form: eight-wheel character lock opened in order
volumes.method: a lock that is also a lesson

arc_clue.found: the ninth seal sits behind the lock's last wheel

volumes.title: The Iron Pagoda Echo
volumes.setting: a tall pagoda whose bells answer when the wind is wrong

inspired_by.work: Journey to the West (pagoda and bell episodes, idea only)
inspired_by.author: Wu Cheng'en

volumes.clue_mechanic: echo-timing chart (which bell answered, after how long, from which floor)
volumes.method: the sound that tells you where the hidden room is

arc_clue.found: the top bell's clapper is shaped like the tenth seal

volumes.title: The Merchant Who Saw the Khan's Paper Money
volumes.setting: a caravan inn and its forgotten cellar vault
volumes.clue_mechanic: counterfeit check (true and false notes told apart by marks)
volumes.final_form: sorted pile: true notes and false notes
volumes.method: the forged clue among real ones

arc_clue.found: a single genuine note in a box of forgeries carries the eleventh seal

volumes.title: The Kingdom Under the Western Sands
volumes.setting: a hidden valley beneath the dunes where the route ends

inspired_by.work: the lost kingdoms of the Silk Road (legend)
inspired_by.author: public legend

volumes.clue_mechanic: seal assembly (twelve seal rubbings fitted into one map)
volumes.final_form: the full route drawn from all twelve seals
volumes.method: the final door that opens only with every earlier piece

arc_clue.found: the twelfth seal; the twelve letters spell GUARDIAN SHEN: Lia's family sealed the tombs to protect a buried library, and Lia must decide whether to open it
